title: Chapter 141 Recruiting Soldiers
content:
Chapter 141 Recruiting Soldiers

"The tool men I have here have been refreshed. Some soldiers with good qualifications have appeared."

Wang Shuo had already recruited the 10 people with the best qualifications before.

At this time, he was worried about where to find people to form his own cavalry regiment.

This good news came just in time.

"How many military merit points do I have now?"

"6W."

"So many!" Wang Shuo looked at Ayub in surprise. He was not lazy at all.

Wang Shuo checked the recruitment list.

I found that the price of a toolman with similar qualifications as Li Jianguo and others had actually increased to 1,000 military points.

"Old Zhao, you are not kind, you actually raised the price quietly." Wang Shuo joked, deliberately keeping a straight face.

"You kid, don't be dissatisfied. The levels of these tool men all start at level 10. The price is naturally more expensive."

Wang Shuo didn't waste any time and directly recruited 20 people. Because he had to exchange a "cavalry transfer order" for each person, he could only recruit so many people with his current military merit points.

As for the war horses, I got a lot from killing the horse bandits before, which is completely enough.

"Shua...shua..."

Bursts of white light flashed, and a large group of soldiers appeared in front of them.

"Lord!" Although everyone's clothes were shabby, they were still in good spirits.

At least it seems to be much stronger than when Gong Zheng and the others were at the beginning.

Moreover, all the qualifications are A-level, which is what makes Wang Shuo most happy.

You must know that with A-level qualifications, plus one's own territory attributes, the level is increased by 1 level, and the increase in allocable free attributes is as many as 5 points.

"Okay." Wang Shuo smiled and nodded.

Then they exchanged the cavalry transfer certificate for them.

In this way, his cavalry team began to take shape.

Just 6W of military merit points were completely consumed again, which made Wang Shuo feel a little distressed, but it was definitely worth it.

He still has many weapons and armors. The beasts attacked the city and sent him hundreds of sets of sophisticated equipment. In a short time, he no longer had to worry about equipment problems.

"Let's go and meet the boss for a while." Wang Shuo is full of fighting spirit and heroic spirit!

"Wait!"

At this time, Ayub's rich voice sounded.

"Lord, the boss we have to deal with this time is nothing to worry about! We want to enter the orange area and kill the ghost." He looked troubled and said worriedly, "And this ghost can attack from the soul and has no entity. There is nothing we can do."

When Wang Shuo heard this, his brows twisted into the character "Chuan".

Wang Shuo was well aware of the horror of this ghost. He thought back then, he was chased for several kilometers.

He turned to look at Bond Zhao, his face a little uncertain, and asked tentatively: "Old Zhao, can you do anything?"

"Ha ha!"

Zhao Bangde laughed loudly, half-squinted his eyes, and said confidently: "Of course, this is also the second stage of the ancient battlefield."

"If you want to deal with ghosts, soul-protecting equipment is essential."

"The low-end version includes soul defense talisman and soul attack talisman."

"A piece of talisman paper costs 500 military merit points and can last for 1 hour."

"What? Lao Zhao, are you kidding?"

Wang Shuo opened his mouth wide, his pupils suddenly enlarged, and his face was full of disbelief.

Wang Shuo's confidant and favorite general Gong Zheng was only worth 500 military points at first, but now a piece of talisman paper costs 500.

Wang Shuo found it difficult to accept.

Is this talisman made of gold?

"Of course I'm not joking. These ghosts are monsters of more than 20 levels. Each one can provide 10 military merit points. Naturally, the cost of killing them is a bit high."

At this time, Wang Shuo was confused: "Old Zhao, do you know how these talismans are made?"

"Haha, it's too early to talk about this issue now. You will know when you have a certain life skill and have practiced it at an 'advanced' level."

Hearing this, Wang Shuo sighed. Now his military merit points are only in single digits.

Let’s earn military merit points first, and we’ll talk about other things later.
